channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Supreme Court Rejects Trump's Bid to Cut DEI Research Grants
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected a case concerning former President Donald Trump's attempt to cut research grants linked to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives. The court's decision means Trump's bid to reduce funding for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Charged Over Bomb Threat at Illinois Ethanol Plant
item.description: A man has been arrested and charged in connection with a bomb threat made against an ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois. The specific details of the threat and the suspect's motive have not been disclosed. The incident is currently under… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Banker guilty of racist abuse outside London Tube station
item.description: A German banker has been found guilty of racially abusing two sisters outside a London Underground station. The incident involved the banker, identified as the ex-partner of a "Maga" influencer, directing racist slurs at the sisters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Man Destroys US Military Plane at Irish Airport
item.description: A man is accused of destroying a U.S. military plane valued at US$60 million at an Irish airport, according to prosecutors. The specific details of the incident and the man's identity were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Philippine police have filed criminal complaints against Thomas Markle, the estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, for alleged online child sexual abuse offenses. Police stated that Markle is charged with the possession of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is set to deliver a ruling on Thursday regarding whether Myanmar's expulsion of the Rohingya constitutes genocide. Concerns have been raised about potential US sanctions against ICJ judges… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: A highly classified United States national security communications network experienced an outage, according to the National Security Agency (NSA). Sources also confirmed the network went down. The specific nature of the outage and its… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: A critical security flaw, dubbed Java4Shell, has been discovered in Java, the world's third-largest programming language. Security researchers uncovered the bug using AI, and it is reportedly different from a PHP flaw, PHP2Shell, found… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI-generated child abuse images surge 8,400% in US, study finds
item.description: A study has found an 8,400% surge in child sexual abuse material (CSAM) involving artificial intelligence (AI) in the United States over the past two years. The increase was reported by US authorities. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: US intelligence agencies are reportedly concerned that Iran may be plotting to use a "dirty bomb" in Washington D.C. President Donald Trump stated the US is taking these reports seriously. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson has denied… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: A man accused of shooting a constable in West Bengal was killed in a gunfight with police. This incident marks the fifth death in what reports describe as police encounters since the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) came to power in the state… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: The Supreme Court has issued notices to the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), the Congress party, and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) in response to a plea seeking a ban on protests at Ramlila Maidan and Jantar Mantar. Traders claimed that… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Supreme Court has issued a notice to the central government seeking a response regarding the delay in finalizing the Memorandum of Procedure (MoP) for judicial appointments. The apex court noted that the rules have been pending for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Man Kills Wife, Then Dies by Suicide in Bengaluru
item.description: A man allegedly killed his wife in Bengaluru's Panathur area on suspicion of infidelity before dying by suicide. The incident was reported by The Print and Deccan Herald. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Supreme Court issued notices to the Congress party, Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), and the All India Students' Association (AISA) following a plea by traders' bodies. The traders alleged that their businesses were negatively impacted by… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Girl Rescued After Being Kidnapped in Stolen Car
item.description: A 12-year-old girl was rescued by police in Guduvanchery, Tamil Nadu, after she was inside a car that was stolen. The car thief drove approximately 200 kilometers with the child inside before being apprehended and arrested. The girl woke… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court: Skipping Party Meeting is Not Defection
item.description: The Supreme Court heard arguments in the Shiv Sena leadership dispute, with the faction led by Eknath Shinde asserting that skipping a party meeting does not constitute defection. This argument was presented to the court as part of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A Delhi court has directed the police to file an action taken report concerning a complaint against Sonia Gandhi. The complaint relates to an alleged discrepancy in the electoral roll from 1980. The court's order follows a plea seeking an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Madras High Court Orders Seizure and Auction of Stray Cattle
item.description: The Madras High Court has ordered the seizure of stray cattle found on public roads, directing authorities to auction them if they remain unclaimed. The court emphasized that public roads are intended for people and vehicles. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Andaman Islands Repeals Colonial Laws, Implements New Prison Rules
item.description: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands administration has repealed two colonial-era laws and introduced a new prison regulation. The specific laws repealed and the details of the new regulation were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Students Hospitalized After Suspected Pollution from Tar-Mixing Unit
item.description: Approximately 30 to 50 students from Keralam school in Kollam were hospitalized following suspected pollution from a nearby tar-mixing unit. Thick smoke reportedly began drifting into the school premises shortly after the unit resumed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Inspector Suspended for Alleged Collusion with Escaped Accused
item.description: Inspector Vineet Dubey has been suspended by Bastar IG for alleged collusion with Shoaib Dhebar, an accused who escaped in Raipur. Two constables have also been suspended in connection with the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala Suspends Engineer After Boy's Electrocution Death
item.description: An engineer from the Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) has been suspended following the electrocution death of a 13-year-old boy in Tirurangadi. The Human Rights Commission (HRC) has registered a case related to the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian National Missing After Tanker Attack in Strait of Hormuz

item.description: The Supreme Court has scheduled a hearing for December 9 on a plea filed by the INDIA bloc concerning 48 questions related to the Election Commission of India (ECI). The ECI has raised strong objections to the bloc's request to serve these… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: NIA Arrests Khalistan Supporter Surinder Singh at Delhi Airport
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) arrested Surinder Singh, a supporter of the Khalistan Zindabad Force, upon his arrival at Delhi Airport. Singh was deported from the United States to India. Reports indicate he was allegedly involved… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Six police personnel, including an Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP) named Deepak Mishra, have been suspended in Seoni, Madhya Pradesh, following allegations of extortion and threats. A viral video purportedly showed police… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: The Supreme Court of India has suspended the life sentence of two convicts in the 2002 Bilkis Bano rape and murder case, granting them bail. Bilkis Bano has expressed shock at this decision. Following the court's order, Bilkis Bano and her… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Microsoft Outage Caused by Unpatched Bug, Phishing Attacks Reported
item.description: Microsoft has identified a bug, undetected since July, as the root cause of a global outage that affected Outlook, Exchange, and other office software. The outage was triggered by a combination of the bug, malfunctioning internal… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ukraine Strikes Kerch Bridge Linking Russia and Crimea
item.description: Ukraine launched an aerial attack using drones and missiles that damaged the Kerch Bridge, also known as the Crimea Bridge, which connects Russia to occupied Crimea. Traffic on the bridge was halted following the strike. Ukrainian… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 13 · Right 0.

item.description: California has banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on state freeways, citing repeated incursions into active construction zones and an "imminent hazard" to public safety. Following this decision, Waymo has paused its freeway… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has begun a pilot trial of a new system at the Mundka toll plaza on Urban Extension Road-II (UER-II) in Delhi. This system aims to identify vehicles operating on highways without valid… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Elephant Tranquilization Operation Continues for Sixth Day
item.description: A tranquilization operation for an elephant, known as Kabra, has been ongoing for six days. The elephant has reportedly killed 19 people and its behavior has changed after joining a herd of 17 elephants. Previous rescue attempts over five… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: NEET UG Paper Leak: Court Orders Framing of Charges Against 14 Accused
item.description: A court has ordered that charges be framed against 14 accused in the NEET UG paper leak case. The Rouse Avenue Court will frame the charges on November 21 and will hear the case daily. The investigation is ongoing, with authorities… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Paris Hilton lobbies US Congress for DEFIANCE Act against deepfakes
item.description: Paris Hilton visited Capitol Hill to advocate for the passage of the DEFIANCE Act, a bipartisan bill aimed at combating sexually explicit deepfake images. She stated that the abuse she has faced has not stopped and urged the US Congress to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Gérard Depardieu withdraws appeal of sexual assault conviction
item.description: French actor Gérard Depardieu has withdrawn his appeal against a sexual assault conviction. Depardieu had been found guilty of sexual assault in December 2023. He stated, 'I have been found guilty.' Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Teens Die in Police Pursuit Crash in Coweta County
item.description: Two teenagers were killed and one was seriously injured following a car crash that occurred during a police pursuit in Coweta County. A man has been accused of causing the two deaths while fleeing police and reportedly cried in court. He… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian-origin man charged in Minnesota assault case
item.description: An Indian-origin man has been charged in connection with the assault of a Somali Uber driver in Minnesota, United States. The incident reportedly involved the phrase 'I don't like that name.' The victim is described as Somali-American. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Azam Khan Granted Bail in ED Case, Allahabad HC Calls Arrest 'Motivated'
item.description: Azam Khan has been granted bail in a case registered by the Enforcement Directorate (ED). The Allahabad High Court, while granting bail, stated that the arrest was 'motivated'. The Supreme Court, however, refused to pause Azam Khan's… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 1.
